title: Onboarding
note: Body far past the 60-character hard maximum so one element splits across several chunks: the only sample where Chunk supports Structure is many-to-one.

elements.content: Provision the workspace, install the toolchain, and confirm the data tier answers before touching the graph. The eval corpus is rebuilt from scratch on every run, so a partially provisioned environment reads as a corpus defect rather than as the environment problem it is. Bring FalkorDB up first, then Postgres, then the worker, and only then seed the tenant you intend to evaluate against.
Confirm each service before the next.
